games.name: BEAR THE BURN: A Stock Market Deckbuilder
7 Eclipsed Fates
games.summary: A dark mystery visual novel RPG focused on deduction and branching choices. Explore a 360° rotatable panoramic map, collect cards and build randomized decks for turn-based combat, uncover the truth hidden in the mist and unlock multiple endings.

games.name: Anime Fitness - Power Workout
games.summary:
Train with pro anime trainers, push your limits, and get stronger with every session! Choose your trainer, level, and routine — then jump into 30 minutes of intense full-body workout.

Turn fitness into a fun, motivating, and interactive anime experience.

Choose your personal trainer, select your level, and begin your custom fitness journey through structured workouts that keep you challenged and inspired.

Each session combines 7 different exercises, performed for 1 minute 30 seconds with short 30-second breaks — repeated twice for a full 28-minute workout plus warm-up. With over 100 exercises, there are endless variations to keep every session fresh.

Build your personal training schedule across weeks or months, earn rewards for staying consistent, and watch your strength and endurance grow. Each trainer brings unique energy, voice, and encouragement to help you stay motivated.

Vibrant visuals, dynamic environments, and pumping music transform every workout into a fitness adventure. Whether you’re just starting out or chasing peak performance.

This game will help you to stay active, healthy, and motivated long-term.
Read less

Software description provided by the publisher.

games.name: As the Lady Chooses
games.summary: Seek your perfect match in Regency London! A wealthy suitor would save your family from ruin—but what about your heart and your literary dreams? An interactive Regency romance novel, 259 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

games.name: Auction House 2
games.summary: Build a fantasy trading empire in a single-player idle crafting game. Hire gatherers and crafters, turn raw materials into valuable goods, and outtrade rival merchants. Set your prices, collect your sales and grow your warband between visits.

games.name: Auto Mutant Creatures
games.summary: A roguelite autobattler where your build can outlive your creatures. Assemble three mutants with risky powers and wild synergies, position your squad, and watch them fight. Choose a mutation and pass some upgrades to the next generation. Play Solo or asynchronous online PvP.

games.name: Bamboo Ronin: The Last Cut
games.summary: A retired ronin picking up his sword one last time, and a bamboo forest that has grown over his whole life. Cut your way through it one swing at a time, haul the pieces home, sharpen your blade and find out what's waiting at your old master's grave.

games.name: Be Beautiful Forever! - Villa NEPENTHES -
games.summary: 『いつまでも美シク - Villa NEPENTHES -』は、探索するほど老いていく、孤島館ホラーADV。若さを奪う館の真相を暴き、偽装工作で敵を欺き、崩れゆく島から脱出せよ。

games.name: Black Border 3
games.summary:
Step into the inspection booth in Black Border 3, a thrilling dystopian border simulation game. Review complex documents, interrogate suspicious travelers, and uncover clever smuggling plots.

Earning your keep is crucial to surviving your 50-night assignment. Spend your hard-earned credits at the Supply Shop on tactical consumables, scanners, and speed boosts. 

Your shift is filled with difficult moral choices, unique characters, and even famous historical figures. Approve or reject them carefully, as your decisions lead to multiple branching endings seamlessly recorded in your Memory Bank. A single mistake could trigger a diplomatic incident, so choose wisely.

games.name: BlackOut!
games.summary: How long can you brain survive the Black Out!

games.name: Bookkeeper
games.summary: Sort over 3,500 real books into their proper places and bring order to a grand library, one shelf at a time.

games.name: BOOMER (Wumbo Workshop)
games.summary: BOOMER is a chaos-filled co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Inhabit a zany cast of customizable puppet characters as you explore derelict environments, encounter forgotten monsters and play a deadly game of hot potato with everyone's favorite little rascal, Boomer!

games.name: CASHGRAB
games.summary: Defeat enemies and grab your cash as fast as possible in this arcade time attack 2D platformer starring Joey The Duck!

games.name: Casual Mystery Solving: 1-Minute Detective Mysteries
games.summary:
Can you spot what feels off?

Every scene hides a clue that does not belong. Can you find it before the mystery slips away?

No special knowledge is needed—just a sharp eye and a little intuition. This illustrated mystery game presents each case as a quick one-question challenge.

Study strange incidents and puzzling scenes to figure out where something feels wrong. Once you find the suspicious detail, discover the explanation and enjoy the story of what happened next.

How to play:
• Examine the illustration
• Search the scene for an odd or unnatural detail
• Click the suspicious area
• Learn the truth through the explanation and aftermath story

Each challenge is quick and easy to pick up, making it perfect for a short break or a few minutes of sleuthing. Play alone and think it through, or ask family and friends, “What looks wrong here?”

Recommended for anyone who enjoys mysteries, illustrated puzzles, finding hidden clues, and uncovering the truth behind an incident. Spot the detail that does not fit, then follow the case through to its surprising conclusion!

games.name: Cave Diving With Friends
games.summary: Cave Diving With Friends is a chaotic co-op adventure for up to four players. Squeeze through cramped passages, explore unpredictable caves, gather valuable loot and try not to lose your friends, or yourself in the darkness and dangers of the caves.

games.name: Charoite into the Deep
games.summary: This is an action RPG in which Charois, a little witch, goes underground with her golem. Using skills such as “dowsing” and items found in the game, players can safely reach the deepest part of the basement by avoiding traps and threats from powerful enemies.

games.name: Cheat or Fold
games.summary: Cheat or Fold is a singleplayer programming game built around Texas Hold'em. Write your own scripts, automate your play and manipulate simulated poker clients from a retro desktop.

games.name: Chigusa's Diary
games.summary: Chigusa was just an everyday schoolgirl, but once she began to notice the boys, her life gradually started to change in unexpected ways...

games.name: Christmas Workshop: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: The elves pulled an all nighter and the workshop is buried under a mountain of toys! Grab up to 7 friends, climb the pile and put thousands of teddies, trains and presents back where they belong before Santa's inspection. Cozy, chaotic, satisfying co-op.

games.name: Cielvia-Inherited By Defeat-
games.summary: Turn defeat into power. Gain new abilities by falling to your enemies, grow stronger with every attempt, and overcome relentless trials in this survivors-like action game. Switch between Light and Dark forms to create your own unique combat style.

games.name: Clara Wraiths 3
games.summary: Clara Wraiths 3 is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a psychic, called Clara, who investigates the various haunted locations in the US in order to help the spirits move on or find peace.

games.name: CyberKitty: Neon Merge
games.summary: There's a crazy farmer out there and he's trying to catch you! Let's show this madman who's the fastest in town!

games.name: Dead Harvest
games.summary: Prepare your defenses. The dead are coming. Dead Harvest is a tower defense game where you must protect your territory from hordes of zombies. Your turrets won’t be doing all the work: you’ll also have to fight the zombies by running them over with your motorcycle!

games.name: DELIVERX
games.summary: An online game for four players in which you and your friends will need to deliver packages and escape from monsters. Deliver packages, level up, and try to deliver everything.

games.name: Disco Ball Simulator 2000
games.summary: You owe 1 million $ and all you have is a disco ball! A hectic but satisfying incremental swiping game about creating the perfect party night with light effects. Juggle cooldowns, upgrade equipment, earn $$$ and most importantly: Make numbers go up!

games.name: Dummy Works
games.summary: Unleash chaos on test dummies in this physics sandbox, but not all is as it seems.

games.name: Dungeon Cooking
games.summary: Dungeon Cooking is a dark fantasy cooking roguelike about feeding a plague-struck town. Send heroes into the dungeon for ingredients, cook what they bring back, test ingredients on rats, heroes, or citizens, and keep the kitchen alive as the town slowly falls apart.

games.name: Dungeon Defense
games.summary: Build a goblin dungeon and defend your treasure in this tower defense roguelite. Place rooms, set traps, and combine items to stop invading heroes in automated battles. Unleash boss commands, earn permanent upgrades, and refine your strategy between runs.

games.name: Dyna-Brix
games.summary: Dyna-brix is the new indie brick breaker game. Destroy bricks on dynamic levels to an original and dynamic soundtrack, with precise controls and physics and minimalistic and readable visuals.

games.name: Empires of the Axis and Abyss
games.summary: A 4X asynchronous galactic strategy game. Eight houses, one shattered galaxy, two to eight commanders. Design fleets, fight three-band battles with named captains, and take your turn when you have ten minutes. Campaigns can run for weeks without a fixed game night.

games.name: Fantasy Camp Builder
games.summary: A cozy campsite building game where you create medieval-fantasy campsites with charming decorations, warm lighting, and a relaxing atmosphere.

games.name: Faroda
games.summary:
Faroda is a challenging 2D platformer with colorful pixel-art graphics and chiptune soundtrack.

Travel across the 5 islands of a remote archipelago, completing over 100 levels, collecting treasure chests and many hidden gems along the way.

Will you be able to help Faroda, the protagonist of this adventure, gather the immense wealth scattered across these islands?

And most importantly: will you be able to find the legendary artifact?

games.name: Figment
games.summary: A musical action-adventure set in the recesses of the human mind... Welcome to the world of Figment. A strange and surreal world; a place filled with our deepest thoughts, urges and memories, populated by the many voices we hear in our heads. This mind has been quiet and calm for many years. But something has changed. New thoughts have started to emerge -- taking the shape of nightmarish creatures who spread fear wherever they go. The only hope is for the grumpy Dusty, the mind's former voice of courage, to get back to his old self and help the mind to face its fears. Join Dusty and his ever-optimistic friend, Piper, on an adventure through the different sides of the mind, solving puzzles to set things straight, beating back the nightmares and seeking to restore the courage that's been lost.

games.name: Figment 2: Creed Valley
games.summary:
Piano bridges, dancing plants and musical showdowns, ready to dive into The Mind?

Nightmares have shattered the Moral Compass, making The Mind unable to function properly. Dusty and his ever-optimistic sidekick, Piper, must travel to Creed Valley, where The Mind's ideals are formed to restore peace. 

Figment 2: Creed Valley is an action-adventure game set in the human mind. Nightmares are spreading chaos and have overrun once-peaceful lands. Join Dusty, The Mind's courage, as you make your way through puzzles, musical boss fights and unique environments.

Face your fears head-on.

games.name: File.BMR.01208
games.summary:
I'm not good at taglines. Check out this little shooter game my dad made!

Hi, my name is Hana! I'm releasing my father's untitled game software. Although it looks unfinished, it is playable and still contains all the features.

- 7 different Styles (costumes) that affect gameplay.
- 7 different Filters (screen colors) to choose from.
- 14 Badges (achievements) to collect.
- An old video of my father ranting about his job

games.name: Find Cats 9: Hidden Treasures
games.summary: Three epic fantasy battlefields, dozens of sneaky cats! Crown battles in the treasury, mermaids vs. skeleton pirates in a deep-sea wreck, dwarves vs. goblins for an ale flagon in the gold vault—find them all!

games.name: Flag Fiasco: Tidy Up
games.summary: A cozy first-person tidy-up game where the whole world is a mess. Find 2,000 flags scattered across a grand oval room, spot the fakes, rescue flags from plushies and put every one back where it belongs on a giant world map. No timers, just order.

games.name: Flame, Forest & Flood
games.summary: A cozy three-player strategy showdown where simple rules meet surprising depth. Easy to learn, endlessly re-playable, and built so everyone can play, and anyone can win.

games.name: Form
games.summary: Feed, observe, and raise FORM, a mysterious digital entity living on the RÆLOS desktop. In this atmospheric idle simulation, time passes even while you are away. Explore files, complete quests, play minigames, and decipher the traces left by every cycle.

games.name: Fungarium
games.summary: Every day, villagers bring you their baskets. Turn each specimen over under the loupe, cut it open and watch the flesh, smell it, ask where it was picked, and take a spore print. Check Agnes’s field guide. Then bring down the stamp: edible, remedy, refuse, or poison.

games.name: Goat Simulator 3: Ticket to Dizzyworld
games.summary:
Welcome to Dizzyworld. An immersive goat-themed baa-musement park, letting you reach higher ups and downs than your mood swings. 

Did you manage to save the Multiverse AND survive the apocalypse?

Take a well-deserved break and feel the g(oat)-force on the many thrilling rides the park has to offer, turn innocent visitors into baalloons, watch them puke, and trade Dizzy Tokens for sweet rewards. 

Sounds like vacation to me. 

Secure your ticket today, enjoy the dizziness later.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
games.summary: Vice City, USA. Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida – forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive. [GTA VI]

games.name: Grand Theft Timeline
games.summary: Pull a time travel heist with your friends. Operate a makeshift time travel machine to traverse the timeline with 200+ buttons, then arrive at a time era, explore it, find the valuable, and steal it. Just don't get stranded and become part of the timeline yourself. 1-8 players.

games.name: Head-Over-Heels! Fantasy World Montage Puzzle ~From the Saint to Monster Girls~
games.summary:
Will you take a closer look at me? ♥

Ever wondered who might appear in this mysterious fantasy world?

A saintly beauty with a gentle smile. A proud and graceful knight. A charming monster girl with a mischievous side.

Meet a colorful cast of fantasy beauties in an exciting montage puzzle.

How to play:
・Take a good look at the character
・Compare the mixed-up horizontal strips
・Rotate each reel to assemble the right outfit

From a pure and lovely saint to a monster girl with a teasing smile, every character brings her own special charm. Find the perfect combination by carefully comparing the details, then enjoy the satisfying moment when the montage comes together.

Clearing a puzzle may even reveal a slightly sweet message from the girl you met.

With intuitive gameplay and no complicated controls, it is perfect for a quick break or a little fun whenever you have time.

Which fantasy beauty will appear next? Complete every montage and enjoy meeting the captivating girls of this otherworldly realm!

games.name: Heavy Cargo - The Truck Simulator: Miami Vibes Pack
Hidden Kitten: Anime Waifu
games.summary:
Can you spot the one hidden kitten?

Which tiny visitor is hiding in plain sight?

You know that feeling when something adorable blends perfectly into the scene? Search through charming illustrations of anime-style girls in settings like cafés, libraries, aquariums, and campsites, each wearing a different outfit, to find the one hidden kitten.

How to play:
• Carefully scan every corner of the illustration
• Look for the kitten blended into the scenery or small objects
• Tap it when you find it to clear the picture!

The kitten may even hide in the shape of a cloud or a shadow. Relax with cute characters and an adorable kitten while testing your observation and concentration.

Recommended for:
• Cat and anime-style illustration fans
• Anyone who enjoys hidden pictures and seek-and-find games
• Players looking for a quick game for spare moments
• Anyone who wants to sharpen their observation skills
• Friends who want to search together and celebrate every discovery

Take your time admiring the illustrations, or race to find the kitten as quickly as possible. Enjoy a relaxing search on your own, or share the excitement with viewers when you shout, “There it is!”

games.name: Imago.Zero
games.summary: This is a fan-made InaSure visual novel inspired by ALDNOAH.ZERO.

games.name: IT THINKS! - Build Your Own GPU
games.summary: Design the chip that powers AI. Start with a single logic gate and build a computer: wire circuits, cast designs into reusable chips, program tiny kernels, and scale your architecture into a working GPU.

games.name: Kaiju Krush
games.summary: Grow from a tiny kaiju into a city-crushing colossus. Smash buildings, recruit hatchlings and spend your spoils on mutations. Molt for permanent Evolutions, unlock optional automation and tear through 15 districts to the Skybreak Citadel.

games.name: Kids Minesweeper
games.summary:
Chop down trees, dodge slimes, and explore the forest! Use numbers as clues to identify dangerous tiles. A pixel-art puzzle game for kids and adults alike!

Kids Minesweeper is a pixel-art puzzle game where you use numbers as clues to figure out which tiles are safe.

Cut down the trees covering the forest and investigate one tile at a time.
When you cut down a tree, you may uncover a wooden sign carved with a number.

Each number tells you how many slimes are hiding in the eight surrounding tiles.
Use the numbers as clues to identify safe tiles and continue your expedition without running into slimes.

You can also place markers on tiles you suspect are dangerous.
Deciding which tiles to investigate and which ones to mark is the key to success!

games.name: Kill You Again
games.summary: A choice-driven psychological horror visual novel. Wake up as Haru, a streamer trapped in a beautiful fantasy world that resets with every death. Uncover hidden scenes, revisit familiar moments with new memories, and escape an endless death loop alongside the mysterious Elinia.

games.name: KUROSHIO: Neon Blood
games.summary: Tokyo, at night, in the rain. Twelve years after vanishing, Kyōsuke Narumi returns to Shinbashi and walks straight into a war between yakuza families. An open-world crime saga: brawls, katana and gunfights, police chases, mountain-pass races and a shinkansen to the old capital.

games.name: Kurousa Just Wants to Go Home
games.summary: All Kurousa wants is to go home. But a mountain of office supplies stands in the way. Grab onto objects with his long ears and swing your way up. No checkpoints—one fall can undo all your hard work. He falls, he cries, and he reaches again. Can you get Kurousa home on time?

games.name: LifeStock
games.summary: FREE FOR THE DAY - Bugs everywhere! Crush the Bugs! The bugs rushed and ruined crops and homes. Use your powerful weapons and wisdom to destroy the bugs! It is your turn to exterminate those pesky critters to stop the infestation. * You pick your exterminating Ammo * 20 Challenging Levels with Crops and Homes to Protect How to Play: 1. Tap to start the Catapult 2. Tap again when you think the weapon should be launched from the Catapult Let the extermination start now!!

games.name: Light the Void
games.summary: Light the Void is a pixel-art incremental exploration game. Reveal a mysterious world one tile at a time, gather resources, restore ancient structures, and unlock powerful upgrades. Grow your void world, overcome colossal titans, and bring light.

games.name: Lost Sock Simulator 3000
games.summary: Be a sweetheart and help Gertrude Knitmore find all her lost socks. An idle clicker about humanity's oldest unsolved mystery. And yes, there's an ending. The universe has opinions about your sock collection.

games.name: Manga Shop: Tidy Up!
games.summary: Tidy up thousands of manga volumes in a chaotic Japanese bookstore. Pick them up, find the right shelves, unlock new abilities, and turn total chaos into a cozy manga paradise. Play solo or with friends in online co-op.

games.name: Medical Girls
games.summary:
A Puzzle Game Featuring Women Working in the Medical Field!

Collect puzzle pieces featuring women working in the noble field of medicine and complete each puzzle!

There are 15 stages in total, with the difficulty increasing as you progress!

Stages 1–10 feature 30 pieces, while stages 11–15 feature 50 pieces.

The final stage offers an extra challenge with no faded background image to guide you! Take your time examining each piece and put the puzzle together!

Complete a puzzle to unlock a high-resolution illustration in the gallery.

games.name: Meowinks Tidy or Else
games.summary: Meowinks Tidy or Else is a nighttime organizing sim where you must sort over 5,000 toys! Upgrade your character and leave the store ready for tomorrow. Just ignore the strange things that happen when no one is looking... He is watching!

games.name: Mind the Tilt
games.summary: Your house is balanced on a pin, and everything in it has weight. Do the jobs, keep it level, and don't be the one the game names for tipping it. A physics party game for 1 to 8 players, on one PC or online, across 29 houses that each tip in their own way.

games.name: MiniHero: Wonderbound
games.summary: A whimsical pixel‑fantasy card adventure. Every step holds hidden risk — make your choices between opportunity and peril.

games.name: Monk & The Misfit Monsters
games.summary: Transform worthless little monsters into legendary warriors inspired by the Journey to the West. Recruit, upgrade, and customize a five-member party, overcome the Eighty-One Trials, defeat powerful demons, obtain the sacred scriptures, and ascend to Buddhahood.

games.name: My Life: Safari Vet
games.summary: A lion cub needs your help – quick! Grab your vet bag and set off on a wild safari adventure! Examine animals, nurse them back to health, and discover Africa’s amazing wildlife. On foot or in your jeep, your next exciting animal rescue is just around the corner!

games.name: My Pet Seduced Me: Save Animal Boys from the Monster
games.summary:
Your pet came back as a cute guy with ears and a tail. Now he needs you to save the others.

Your quiet Japanese town woke up different.

The pets are gone. In their place: monsters prowling the streets, and a handful of animal boys who somehow kept their hearts. Ears, tails, sharp style, and feelings they're not shy about.

Yours found you first. Turns out he's had a crush on you for a while.

Head out and find the others before the monsters do. Sneak past corrupted pets or take them down, learn new attacks, and meet the animal boys hiding in parks, side streets, and train platforms.

Spend time with them. Get closer. Every boy you win over heals you, shares his power with you, and unlocks illustrations and scenes in your gallery.

-A cat boy who acts cool but wants your attention anyway.
-A dog boy who'd follow you anywhere.
-A bunny boy who's all nerves, until he isn't.

Fall for them. Fight for them. Then face the bosses running this town.

games.name: My Pet Seduced Me: Save Animal Girls from the Monster
games.summary:
Your cat just turned into a girl. She's flirting with you. And the town is crawling with monster pets.

Something weird happened in your quiet little Japanese town.

Overnight, the pets changed. Most of them turned into aggressive monsters that now roam the streets. A lucky few turned into something else entirely: gorgeous animal girls with ears, tails, and plenty of attitude.

Including yours. And she's very happy to see you.

Explore the town, fight or run from corrupted pets, and track down the animal girls hiding in parks, back alleys, train stations, and convenience stores.

Ask them out. Win them over.

Every heart you conquer heals you, gives you new powers, and unlocks illustrations for your gallery.

The stronger your bonds, the stronger you get. You'll need it, because the biggest and weirdest bosses in town are waiting.

-A clingy cat girl who won't leave you alone.
-A loyal dog girl who'd fight a monster for you.
-A shy bunny girl who's way bolder than she looks.

games.name: Mystery of the Mysterious Futayuri Mystery Dungeon
MYSTHORN GIRLS
games.summary:
A Puzzle Game Featuring a Cast of MYST HORN GIRLS!

Collect the pieces featuring adorable girls with mystical horns and complete each puzzle!

There are 15 stages in total, with the difficulty increasing as you progress!

Stages 1–10 feature 30 pieces, while stages 11–15 feature 50 pieces.

The final stage offers an extra challenge with no faded background image to guide you! Take your time examining each piece and put the puzzle together!

Complete a puzzle to unlock a high-resolution illustration in the gallery

games.name: Netherwake
games.summary: Netherwake is a story-driven first-person psychological horror game. Explore a town consumed by unnatural fog and a facility beneath the mountain. Hide from deadly anomalies, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover what happened before they find you.

games.name: No More Seats
games.summary: A tense first-person horror-thriller about a city evacuation. Test passengers at the bus stop, question their stories and decide who boards the last bus, because one hidden Listener on board means the end for everyone.

games.name: Once You Know the Truth, These Comics Become Scary
games.summary:
Spot the oddity. Face the fear.

An ordinary day unfolds in a comic strip.
But look closer, and something feels wrong...

Search through four-panel comics for hidden oddities, then uncover the chilling truth behind them in this horror mystery visual puzzle game.

How to play:
• Read the comic and its dialogue carefully
• Look for anything unnatural or out of place
• Select the spot you think is hiding the answer

No complicated controls are needed.

Each stage is a quick, self-contained challenge, so you can take on the puzzles at your own pace. With 40 stages in total, every scene invites you to look again and trust your instincts.

What seems like an ordinary moment may reveal something deeply unsettling when you examine it closely.

All you need is careful observation and a little imagination. Horror and mystery fans, as well as anyone who enjoys quick visual puzzles, will find plenty to investigate.

Find the oddity hidden in each comic and discover the terrifying truth waiting behind it.

games.name: One in 1.4 Billion
games.summary: In China, a baby is born about every four seconds, and you are the next one. Be born at random into one of 34 provinces and 56 ethnic groups, weighted by real statistics, then live one life year by year, from birth certificate to obituary. No guide. Just one life.

games.name: Onward! Autobattles
games.summary: Plan your line-up, set your formation and unleash devastating synergies to crush your enemies. Win battles to unlock more unique units and powerful artifacts in Onwards! Autobattles - a roguelike autobattler, where positioning is everything.

games.name: Pack The Cats
games.summary:
One box. Too many cats. Absolutely no personal space. Getting them all in? That's the cozy puzzle games.

If I fits, I sits. The trouble is, every cat wants to sit in the same box. Find a place for each stubborn kitty and enjoy that perfect click when everyone settles in.

With charming illustrated cats, warm colors and a calm pace, it's the purrfect pick for a quick break, a cozy evening or anyone who has ever watched a cat squeeze into a box far too small for it.

Every level gives you a grid and a crowd of cats waiting for their turn. Some curl into a neat little loaf, some stretch out long and tall, and some sprawl across the board with a tail that goes wherever it pleases. Every one of them is an original, hand-drawn character.

Plan around the yarn balls, try different arrangements and find the one layout where every cat has room to rest. There's no rush - just you, a box full of kitties and that wonderful feeling when the last cat finally slips into place.

games.name: Paper Train Rush
games.summary: All aboard for a wild paper-world adventure! Race across 5 continents and 6 mysterious dimensions, unlock 14 trains and 15 quirky characters, and overcome crazy obstacles. Challenge your friends in hilarious local split-screen multiplayer with shooting, dynamite, and plenty of chaos!

games.name: Party Box
games.summary: Welcome to the Gangster Law Attack Platform!This app, exclusive for iPhone and iPad, provides you a new and fun way to attack other players in Gangster Law, a rapidly growing MMORPG.Bringing great graphics, smooth animations and realistic sounds to your gaming experience!With this app you have a new and exclusive way to attack other players, check your events and perform other important actions related to your game play!A must have to improve your Gangster Law playing experience!

games.name: Pathfinding
games.summary: Every day is a new chance to rise to the top of the leaderboard! Dodge those filthy squares, push your reflexes to the limit, and prove you’ve got what it takes to see the Matrix. Only the sharpest players will survive long enough to claim the crown. Can you outlast them all and become the one?

games.name: Paw's Boba Shop
games.summary: Run a cozy boba shop and craft unique drinks. Create your own recipes, unlock new ingredients, records, and decorations as your little shop grows through the seasons.

games.name: Peril and Plunder
games.summary: Peril & Plunder is a multiplayer dungeon-crawling card game for 2–8 players. Fight monsters, grab loot, and turn on your allies. Play the hand the dungeon gives you—and when you die, return as a ghost to meddle with the survivors.

games.name: Play & Learn My First English
games.summary:
Can you complete each English word?

What happens when a picture gives you a clue and a word is missing a letter? Choose the right answer and take your first step into English!

This simple English learning quiz uses four choices to help you practice the alphabet and everyday words in a fun, game-like way.

How to play:
• Look at the picture and the partially completed English word
• Think about which letter belongs in the blank
• Choose the correct letter from four options to complete the word

With 120 stages featuring familiar words such as “apple” and “bird,” it is easy for new English learners to get started. Seeing the picture together with the word makes each challenge approachable and enjoyable.

There is no difficult typing—just choose an answer from the options. Move through one question at a time at your own pace, whether you are practicing every day or fitting in a little learning during a break.

Great for anyone who wants to:
• Start learning English
• Explore basic English words in a fun way
• Learn the alphabet and vocabulary together
• Become more comfortable with English through play
• Find a short, easy learning game

Use the pictures as clues, choose the letters, and complete one English word after another!

games.name: Pokart
games.summary: Play with friends in this poker-based kart racer- Get the best hand and cross the finish line before you lose it!

games.name: PomoIdle Arena
games.summary: A Pomodoro timer × idle × command-battle RPG. Resources build up while you work — pull commands, power up your party, and battle other players between sessions. Your focused time becomes your strength.

games.name: Portrait Photography Master
games.summary: Experience realistic photography simulation. Master exposure, focus, and depth of field, and explore how cameras and lenses shape each shot. Take photo jobs, shoot, edit, and deliver your work to upgrade your gear. Meet new friends through campus life and weekend shoots.

games.name: Purgatory -NARAKU-
games.summary: Purgatory -NARAKU-, The Game

games.name: Puzzlozenge
games.summary: Rotate groups of three diamond-shaped tiles to restore the illusion of a colorful cube. Choose from eight puzzle sizes, ranging from 12 to 243 tiles, and race against the clock to beat your personal best. Simple rules, precise controls, endless challenges.

games.name: Rainbow Romance: College Boys in Love
games.summary:
He says you’re just his buddy. So why is he still texting you at 2 a.m.?

On paper, this college is the straightest place on earth. Big games, loud parties, guys who never stop talking about girls. Funny how none of them ever seem to have one around.

Look closer and the cracks start to show. The hug that lasts a second too long. The joke that isn’t really a joke. The text that arrives at 2 a.m. and is gone by morning.

The swim captain with a girlfriend he never mentions. The musician who writes love songs and won’t say who they’re for. The top student who swears he has no time for distractions, then saves you a seat every single day. They all have a story they’re not telling.

Every conversation pulls the truth a little closer, or makes him back off. Move too fast and he panics. Say the right thing and he finally drops his guard. In private chat, he’s a different guy entirely.

The pool after practice. The empty music room. The long walk back from the party when everyone else is gone. This campus is full of secrets, and some of them are about you.

games.name: Rainbow Romance: College Girls in Love
games.summary:
A crush she’d never admit to anyone. Except you. Thirty days to make her prove it.

Everyone at this college has it all figured out. Perfect boyfriends, perfect photos, perfect stories. At least, that’s what they want you to believe.

Behind the smiles, every girl here is hiding something. A glance that lasts too long. A message deleted before it’s sent. A secret she’s never told anyone, not even herself.

The volleyball captain with the boyfriend everyone envies. The class president who claims she has no time for romance. The party girl who kisses anyone on a dare and calls it a joke. Each one has a reason to keep you at arm’s length, and you have thirty days to find out if it’s real.

Every conversation is a test. Push too hard and she shuts down. Read her right and the mask slips, just for a moment. And in private chat, she says things she’d never admit out loud.

The library after closing. The rooftop when the party gets too loud. The walk home when she finally stops pretending. This campus keeps its secrets well. You’re about to learn every one of them.

games.name: Relic Looter
games.summary: Explore Ancient Ruins and Mysterious Temples! Dodge Deadly Traps and Discover Legendary Treasures! Grab the Loot. Escape Alive!

games.name: Retro Rig 48: Skyline League
games.summary: Retro-styled arcade stunt racing. Launch your rig over gaps, rooftops and canyons across 12 tracks, nail clean landings and chase the fastest time. No ads, no accounts, no in-app purchases. Just pure offline racing.

games.name: Reverie in the Moonlight
games.summary: In Reverie in the Moonlight, scary monsters are chasing you, and you can’t fight them...but your plushies can. Can your adorable friends protect you from these nightmares?

games.name: Ritebound
games.summary: Guide a group of cultists to a mysterious portal! Place boxes, build bridges and stairs, use trampolines, avoid deadly traps, and find the right path through 40 puzzle-platforming levels.

games.name: Rocket Scrapyard
games.summary: Tidy up a private space company's scrapyard, collect rocket parts into sets on your racks and build your own rocket every evening. In the morning it launches – will it reach the edge of space, orbit, or help build a space station?

games.name: Salt of the Earth
games.summary: An isometric medieval city builder. You hold one manor by charter: lay the roads, work the fields, and raise hovels into town houses by meeting what each household needs. Winters take stores, the Crown takes dues, and raiders take whatever will burn.

games.name: Sardoinky
games.summary: Sardoinky is an oddly satisfying case-opening clicker. Rip open sardine tins, flip the fish inside, and cash in. Build a crew of oddballs to keep the cans coming, unlock auto-openers and powerful upgrades, and chase that one legendary pull. Strangely addictive.

games.name: Shards of Veyara
games.summary: Shards of Veyara is an adventure game that blends farming with 3D platformer action. Explore the sky islands of Veyara—a world warped across space and time—gather seeds and resources, cultivate crops in your hub to grow stronger, and reclaim the shattered Dimensional Shards!

games.name: Shattered Realms (Hussein Hadi Mohammed)
games.summary: The outbreak has spread across six cities. Fight through endless zombie hordes as your gun fires on its own, grow stronger every minute, and take down six legendary monsters - each born from the myths of its own country.

games.name: SILO 7
games.summary: Dig through a collapsing nuclear silo, collect fuel cells and escape before the countdown hits zero. Falling monitors turn every tunnel into a trap. Plan your route, step aside at the right moment and race for three stars in this arcade puzzle game.

games.name: Sokobomb
games.summary: Sokobomb is a puzzle game about blowing things up to find your way forward.

games.name: Spellraid
games.summary: Command a modern army against monsters in turn-based battles across Europe. Recover the wounded, study enemies to reveal their health and damage, and decide which front to hold as the invasion spreads.

games.name: Spin Girlfriend! ~Secret Date at the Water Park~
games.summary:
Can you complete every summer memory?

A secret date at the water park is waiting for you!

Splash around by the pool, enjoy the water slides, and take a break together in swimsuits. Her more daring summer look may leave your heart racing!

The gameplay is simple:
・Rotate the mixed-up photo pieces
・Turn every piece to the correct direction
・Complete the photo to clear the puzzle

With intuitive controls and quick-to-learn puzzles, it is great for puzzle fans and perfect for a short break whenever you have a few minutes to spare.

Complete each photo and enjoy a special summer moment together. Can you finish every memory?

games.name: Spin It Lupin!
games.summary: Rotate four gems to form a matching 2×2 square! Clear all connected gems of the same color and trigger chain reactions as new gems fall. Enjoy 100 stages, high-score challenges, and local two-player versus and co-op modes.

games.name: Squircle
games.summary: Launch glowing neon shapes across a floating grid arena and sink them into matching holes, pinball-style. Chase a high score in frantic five-minute runs or play a course of handcrafted neon crazy golf. Two games in one, all using the same shapes and physics. Easy to learn, endlessly masterable.

games.name: STEEL VANGUARD:Project ARES
games.summary: Set in a sci-fi world, this top-down shooter challenges you to complete missions and earn the title of “ARES,” the strongest pilot. Collect modules that appear after clearing each wave to customize and upgrade your mech as you see fit, and aim to clear every wave all the way to the end.

games.name: Strike Warfare : Battle Fury
games.summary: Strike Warfare: Battle Fury is a fast-paced, story-driven military FPS that puts players in the role of an elite Army Captain undertaking an escalating counter-terrorism campaign.

games.name: Sumikkogurashi Welcome to Poka Poka Onsen
games.summary:
In this game, you will work with the Sumikko characters to help out at a busy hot spring inn that is short-staffed, aiming to make it a popular inn where everyone can gather. You will work hard at various jobs such as guiding guests and cleaning, adding new facilities and making it a wonderful hot spring inn.

Use the coins that guests earn by using the facilities to open shops, game corners, and more to develop the inn. The more facilities you add and the higher your level, the more coins you earn, and the more facilities you can open! You can enjoy the excitement of expanding your possibilities and the sense of accomplishment as your inn becomes more lively.

This game offers endless fun and replayability. In this game, you'll experience the satisfaction of gradually expanding a quiet hot spring inn into a vibrant place, while enjoying a relaxing hot spring life with the comical and adorable Sumikko characters.

games.name: Tanks Sweet Tanks
games.summary:
It’s fast. It’s fun. It’s addicting. 

Deafest the enemy tanks while dodging their deadly bullets.  Improve your aim and maneuver skill while war itself is trying to end your adventure. 

Level by level the enemy's tanks get faster, smarter, and deadlier.  Can you make it to the end and defeat their leader? 

Play alone. Play with your friends. Play against your friends.

games.name: Tavern Clicker
games.summary: Run a cozy medieval tavern in this simple clicker. Serve all kinds of guests, unlock new brews, automate your work, and turn a humble alehouse into a tavern worthy of kings!

games.name: Test Tube Water Sort Quiz: Can You Sort the Colors in the Fewest Moves?
games.summary:
How many moves can you save?

Can you spot the smartest route to sort every color?

Colorful liquids fill a set of test tubes, and your challenge is to figure out the minimum number of transfers needed to arrange all the colors. This brain-training quiz puts your observation and forward-planning skills to the test.

You are not moving the liquids yourself. Study the arrangement carefully, imagine the order of the transfers, and choose the correct number of moves from four answer choices.

• Look at the colored liquids in the test tubes
• Think through the transfers needed to sort the colors
• Choose the minimum number of moves from four options

What happens if you move this color first? Could the same result be reached in fewer moves? Looking beyond the current arrangement and imagining what comes next is the key to finding the answer.

With simple rules and surprisingly deep challenges, this logic quiz tests your reasoning, planning, observation, and ability to think ahead. Perfect for fans of brain teasers, color-sorting puzzles, and quick mental challenges.

Take on the challenge and see if you can calculate the fewest moves. Think it through and find the correct answer!

games.name: The Abjuration Stand
games.summary: Defend yourself from hordes of green slimes as a tiny wizard! Build magical orbs, upgrade your weapons, and survive across different locations — from mountains to graveyards. Simple and dynamic 2D defense.

games.name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance + Online
games.summary:
For the first time ever on console, descend together. The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ brings the complete game to console with full online cooperative play for up to four players. Every character, every item, every path, every ending, now with friends online.

Key Features

    Full online cooperative play for up to four players, on console.
    The complete game: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth plus all downloadable content (“Afterbirth,” “Afterbirth+,” “Repentance,” and “Repentance+”).
    Hundreds of items, dozens of characters and endlessly randomized runs.
    Rebalanced items and improvements from years of updates.

games.name: The Final Days of Olin Earl
The Hero is too Powerful so let's Pleeeease Settle this Peacefully!
The Land of Rest 1: Side Stories
The Perfect Quest: The Drowned King's Hoard
games.summary: A text adventure inspired by the Sierra classics. A pirate with a hat and no ship, a sarcastic parrot and a map torn in three: type your way across the Caribbean, dig up chests, forge papers, bribe a skeleton with a fish and out-fence your old captain to a legendary hoard.

games.name: The Return of Illunes
games.summary: A hardcore turn-based roguelike where an AI running on YOUR machine writes each run's story, synergies, oaths, and the names and lore of your loot. Type your own free action — "cut the chandelier loose" — and the AI judges it and narrates the outcome. No servers. No subscription. Fully offline.

games.name: Thexder
games.summary:
Direct from Japan, where game design is treated as an art form, comes Thexder, an arcade game by which all others will soon be judged. Thexder offers more music, animation and game play, than you ever thought possible from a computer game.

In Thexder, players are given the chance to pilot a robot through multiple attack scenarios. The battlefields include caves, vast cargo holds and spaceship interiors. The robot also has the unique ability to transform into a fighter jet (and back again) at the touch of a button. Over 20 different types of aliens will do battle with you, and the challenge and music escalates as the game progresses.

games.name: THINK! LEARN! School Smarts: General Knowledge Quiz Battle
games.summary:
Ready to test your school smarts?

How much do you remember from the classroom? Put your everyday school knowledge to the test in a fun quiz for up to four players.

The rules are easy!

Read each question carefully and choose the answer you think is right from four choices.

Questions cover eight school subjects: language arts, math, science, social studies, English, music, physical education, and home economics.

With plenty of questions to enjoy, it's a fun way for kids to review what they learn at school—and for adults to refresh knowledge from years ago.

Play solo and take your time, or challenge family and friends in a match for up to four players. It's also a great pick for parties and game streaming.

Keep learning as you play and aim for the title of quiz champion!

games.name: Tile Tales: Pirate
games.summary:
Slide tiles, dodge trouble, and hunt for treasure!

Arrr, matey! Get ready for a puzzle adventure packed with pirate mischief, treasure hunting, and tile-sliding chaos!

Help one hopelessly treasure-obsessed pirate find his way across a remote island paradise. Solve 60 uniquely handcrafted puzzles across 6 charming chapters, each with its own lush environment to explore. Along the way, he’ll meet quirky characters, dodge dangerous foes, brave tricky traps, and stumble through more trouble than any pirate deserves.

May your sails be taut and your coffers be full, matey!

games.name: Time Machine : Hidden Objects
games.summary:
Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure through space and time! 

Herbert Fink, a young scientist, faces difficult yet fascinating challenges. An ordinary trip out of town turns into a real investigation, full of intrigue and mysterious temporal anomalies!

Colorful scenery, animation, and 3D visual effects will make your adventure vivid and fun. Those with a competitive streak can collect bonuses for speed and repeat the quest with new puzzles

games.name: Titanhelm
games.summary: Titanhelm is a co-op base building game where you and your friends build a settlement, command a Titan and fight back the creatures of a dark and hostile forest. Gather resources, harvest Soul energy from fallen enemies and upgrade your Titan before the forest consumes you.

games.name: Torchline
games.summary: The sun has fallen asleep. Carry the last ember of daylight in a single torch and lead a column of four east to the Tower of the Sleeping Sun. A fairy-tale, turn-based party RPG where your marching order is your formation — and whoever holds the torch decides what you see.

games.name: Tun
games.summary: Tún is a relaxing gardening game with a light puzzle touch, where you plant seeds, discover new plants, meet kind characters, and shape a peaceful garden of your own. Weather, daily events, and the layout of each patch gently influence what to grow and when, adding a layer of planning without ever becoming stressful. Complete requests, unlock new possibilities, expand your space, and decorate each corner at your own pace. No game over and no pressure, only the quiet satisfaction of helping things flourish.FeaturesGrow a variety of plants through multiple growth stagesEnjoy light puzzle and strategy elements built around garden layout, weather and timingMeet charming characters and complete requests to unlock new stuffExpand your garden with new planting possibilitiesDecorate your garden and make it feel like homePlay at a relaxed pace with no game over and no pressureA beta test will be happening soon, so this is a great time to wishlist the game and follow its development.

games.name: Tunak Wheel Launch
games.summary: Tunak Wheel Launch is a goofy physics game about building a questionable machine and launching a wheel as far as humanly possible. Scavenge and trade for the parts you need, assemble your engine, mount your wheel, and get everything spinning. Once the RPM is high enough, hit the chimney!

games.name: UMAMI (2025)
games.summary: UMAMI is a cozy 3D food puzzle game where every level is a handcrafted, sensory experience. Tinker, rotate, and fit wooden blocks together to build mouthwatering food towers and fantastical cakes, all in a comfy atmosphere, like tidying a bento box for the soul.

games.name: Untitled Shop Game
games.summary: Untitled Shop Game is a shop simulator that lets you unleash your artistic side. Dozens of decorations await, and there are no limits to how, what, or where you place items (well, except for placing stuff on the roads). Oh, and one more thing: the game includes a music player with over 50 songs!

games.name: Vaatar
games.summary: A classic-style arcade game with fast-paced sessions. Descend with your avatar into the desolate mortal world, filled with dangers and monsters, and fight to survive.

games.name: Vending Park: Sort & Stock
games.summary: Vending Park: Sort & Stock is a cozy organizing game where you sort over 1,000 scattered products and put them back into their correct vending machines. Unlock helpful abilities, tidy up at your own pace, and enjoy the satisfaction of restoring order to a messy vending park!

games.name: Viking Nest
games.summary: Create by decorating the North, once torn by war.

games.name: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed
games.summary: Test your memory by watching and listening to the sequence of lights and tones and repeating them if you can.  It starts off easy but quickly becomes challenging!  Challenge your friends on the Game Center and share your skills on Twitter and Facebook.*Brain Cubes is not endorsed by or affiliated with Milton Bradley's Simon game.

games.name: Voxel Breakers
games.summary: Voxel Breakers is a short idle game where you break voxels, spend those broken voxels on Voxel Breakers, and let your Voxel Breakers break even more voxels for you.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
games.summary:
Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 is the brutal and fast-paced sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun.

Following directly on from the end of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, your duty takes you to new locations in a branching, single-player campaign that effortlessly blends the grimdark Warhammer 40,000 universe with a fast-paced first-person shooter.

Take the fight to never-before-seen worlds and vanquish the foes that lurk there. From the colossal heights of a hive city to the impenetrable mangrove swamps of a jungle, you’ll need to overcome the challenges of each biome to complete your mission.

games.name: Work From Dungeon
games.summary: A tiny adventure moves into the corner of your desktop. Click the mage and her monsters fight and grow stronger while you work. Collect and breed 99 monsters, climb toward the last foe waiting at the very end — an idle RPG you never have to stop for.

games.name: World Craft Dream Island
games.summary: Build your dream island block by block – alone or with up to 10 friends online! A cozy voxel sandbox where you mine, craft and survive the night, raise 46 ready-made buildings, tame talking pets and open portals to realms ruled by bosses.

games.name: いつまでも美シク - Villa NEPENTHES -
Alph Last Bastion
games.summary: The bug swarm is coming, and your bastion is the last thing standing in its way. Build a fortress of turrets anywhere on the battlefield, power it up, and hold the line against relentless hordes and monstrous bosses. Fall, upgrade your arsenal, and return stronger.

games.name: Beat That Meat
games.summary: Beat Your Meat is a ridiculous clicker game where you smack your way through 8 types of meat, unlock 8 absurd weapons, and endure relentless sarcastic commentary from a thoroughly unimpressed British woman. You keep beating. She'll keep judging.

games.name: Bee Shrimp Aquarium
games.summary: A 3D aquarium game for watching bee shrimp. Zoom in to see them graze, groom and swim, or feed them and watch them gather. Choose from 12+ aquascapes, change the lighting, and customize the shrimp's patterns, colors and sizes.

games.name: Behelade
games.summary: Wield the “Behelade” to fight your way through this challenging Bullet Hell Shoot ‘Em Up and find out what is behind the mysterious power that made the animals go on a mad Danmaku rampage!

games.name: Big Fox Family Time
games.summary: A cozy first-person family sim where your fox family doubles every night. Hunt, chop, build a den and tuck your kits into bed, then command a crowd of thousands at once, from three kits up to 65,536. Play solo or in online co-op with up to four parents.

games.name: Blamcon's Light Gun Madness
games.summary: Light Gun Madness is a travelling shooting show for your PC Light Guns. Test your skills, play with friends. A great party game. Use one light gun and pass it around to see who gets the best scores or play head to head with 2~4 light guns at the same time. You can use a mouse but it's not the same.

games.name: BlastBeacon
games.summary: Minesweeper, in first person. Step onto the board deep in dark, ancient ruins, read the glowing numbers, and dig with your pickaxe. Just don't hit the wrong block.

games.name: Cats to Mars
games.summary: A strategic 2D physics game where you stack adorable cats to reach Mars. Use each cat's unique size and weight to build your tower as high as possible!

games.name: Chess Variant: Chase The King Demo
Clash of Crests - The Purple and the Fire
Crazy Chess
games.summary: A game based on chess. Solve 50 puzzles on boards of every kind and shape, with different types of tiles. Mechanics and rules that are a little crazy but a lot of fun.

games.name: Crazy Chess – Developer Support Pack - Lvl 1
Crazy Chess – Developer Support Pack - Lvl 2
Crazy Chess – Developer Support Pack - Lvl 3
Crazy Chess – Developer Support Pack - Lvl 4
Crazy Chess – Developer Support Pack - Lvl 5
Desert Cleaner
games.summary: Tidy up the oasis! Scoop the desert into your backpack, turn sand into gold and upgrade from a cotton glove to a full-blown sandstorm. Uncover a green oasis, hidden treasure and helpful robots, alone or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

games.name: Digbound
games.summary: Dig. Sell. Upgrade. Dig deeper.

games.name: Don't Look Back.
games.summary: 『ふりむいちゃだめ』は、廃校となった学校を探索し、怪異から逃げながら脱出を目指すシングルプレイヤー向け3Dホラーゲームです。探索中には「動くな」「高い場所へ逃げろ」「指定された色の場所へ向かえ」「隠れろ」など、さまざまな命令が突然発生します。暗い校舎を探索して鍵やアイテムを集め、安全な場所を見つけながら命令を乗り越えてください。怪異に見つかったときは、教室や廊下、階段を利用して追跡を振り切り、学校からの脱出を目指します。

games.name: DUMMY HOUSE
games.summary: First-person psychological horror and survival. Use your camera and sound to identify and repel enemies that mimic humans in total darkness, uncover disturbing secrets, and face increasingly intense nights in an industrial complex with multiple endings and high replayability.

games.name: Etranger In the City of Doom
games.summary: In a fantasy world floating in the sky, the amnesiac girl Tio sets out to rescue the imprisoned angel Norn. Along the way, she deepens her bond with Rikill, befriends the townspeople, and faces the fate of a dying town. An emotional adventure about growth, friendship, and hope.

games.name: Evil Maiden: The Noble Warrior and the Demon Armor
Fast Point
games.summary: Fast Point is a pickup point business simulator where you start with a small location, a few shelves, and your first customers. Receive deliveries, organize packages in storage, hand out orders, process returns, and make sure the queue doesn't turn into chaos.

games.name: Football Manager: Auto Chess - Idle Desktop Pet Expansion
GIFT from GOD
games.summary: GIFT from GOD is a visual novel told through the eyes of Ryosuke Nikaido and Akane Yamamoto. As they face three missions from God, their hearts, pasts, and choices begin to intertwine, leading them toward the true meaning of God’s “gift.”

games.name: Haunted Echoes
games.summary: Haunted Echoes is a raw psychological horror game experienced through a bodycam perspective. Explore abandoned, eerie locations, manage your limited flashlight, face terrifying anomalies hidden in the dark, and try to survive a nightmare where every single move is being recorded.

games.name: Hero Tower Defense
games.summary: Hero Tower Defense is a top-down roguelike tower defense game. Recruit 70+ unique heroes, use platforms and fences to redirect enemy routes, and combine skills, plugins, equipment, gems, and team bonds. Adapt to randomized recruits, rewards, and enemy compositions across 120 waves.

games.name: Hidden Front
games.summary: Hidden Front is a military real-time strategy game for up to 6 players. Deploy your army, scout through the fog of war and combine infantry, armor, artillery and air support. Fight other commanders or team up with friends against bots.

games.name: Idol On Duty
games.summary: A Beat-Em-Up starring a J-Pop-inspired magical girl Aiko who bashes corporate demons over the head while swapping between a Pop mode and a Metal mode.

games.name: Iron Reactor
games.summary: A Soviet reactor has gone silent. Enter ZHELEZO in this dark retro FPS, battle radioactive mutants and uncover a reality beyond the walls. Fight through 24 levels across four acts, wield seven weapons and face endless enemy waves in Survival mode.

games.name: Kintsugi Cottage
games.summary: A cozy 3D jigsaw restoration game. Hundreds of shards lie across a cottage museum floor, and every glaze, curve and pattern is a clue. Work out which pieces belong together, rebuild the artifacts by hand, and restore the full artifact collection.

games.name: Last Bake
games.summary: You play as a young woman taking a temporary evening job at a bakery on New Year's Eve. Your task is to serve a variety of customers while trying to uncover why, instead of holiday cheer, this place is shrouded in darkness...

games.name: Maximum Aura
games.summary: Farm aura. Bonk googly-eyed NPCs to a phonk beat. Do not get cooked. A frantic top-down arcade survival shooter: auto-fire, dash through crowds, stack ridiculous upgrades, and unleash BRAINROT MODE when your aura bar is full.

games.name: Medieval Adventure
games.summary: Build a medieval settlement into a thriving regional power. Manage villagers, production, seasons and trade; explore a living world, establish resource outposts, forge alliances, and defend your people from bandits and hardship.

games.name: MEIFU KANSHIKI-KA: The Underworld Forensics Division
games.summary: You died at 4:44 a.m. Now you're the Underworld's forensic examiner. Rebuild the shattered memories of the dead with Picross, battle lying spirits, expose false testimony before King Enma — and find out who erased your own page.

games.name: Menio
games.summary: Care unit Pell can see that Runch needs help. MENIO says he isn't eligible. When its supervisor needs that same care, refusal starts to look like revenge. A short psychological horror visual novel about empathy, accountability, and institutional cruelty.

games.name: My Galaxy Buddy
games.summary: A relaxing idler that sits on your desktop. Interact with it on your own terms while you work on other tasks! Extract items from 8 unique biomes! Purchase upgrades to discover rare planets!Customize your UFO and extract items in style!Discover all biomes and collect every item to fill out your archive!

games.name: New Age War: Online
games.summary: A first-person shooter where every bullet is a real projectile with its own speed and drop. Build your weapon from 34 guns, then fight online in lobbies of up to 16 players or against bots across a Mexican valley town, the Ukrainian steppe and an open sea of jets.

games.name: No Visitors Allowed
games.summary: A minimalist psychological horror game inspired by The Exit 8, where players must escape a looping post-Soviet-era abandoned hospital corridor by detecting anomalies.

games.name: Pop Corner
games.summary: A relaxing match-3 that floats in a corner of your screen with a transparent background. Match coffee mugs, folders and sticky notes while you work, without leaving what you're doing.

games.name: Porchlight
games.summary: Summer, 1997. Thirteen-year-old Wes Harlan shines his grandpa's old flashlight into the porch light and opens a door to Callowmere, a storybook kingdom laid out just like his Ohio town. Cross between the two worlds, relight their lamps, and bring the color back to both.

games.name: Prayer Chest
games.summary: A group of young adventurers set out to dispel the darkness lurking within people’s hearts. A nostalgic 3D fantasy RPG inspired by the atmosphere of early‑2000s games.

games.name: Prison Legacy
games.summary: What are you in for? Prison Legacy is a social MMORPG set inside a mixed-gender maximum-security prison. Choose one of 12 criminal classes, then fight turn-based battles, craft contraband, trade, steal, chat, and build a clan strong enough to outlast the hilarious darkness rising behind bars.

games.name: Project Overboard
games.summary: Design a cruise ship deck by deck, hire the crew and take paying guests out to sea. Keep them fed, entertained and away from reception while the buffet runs low, the lifts back up and somebody does something in the pool.

games.name: Rally Panic with the BRO!
games.summary: One drives. One navigates. Both panic! Team up with up to 8 players in 4 cars for chaotic co-op rallying. Dodge wildlife, wipe mud off the windshield, and trust your navigator’s directions. Paint your car, buckle up, and try to keep the friendship on the road.

games.name: Randal's Weekend
games.summary: A lighthearted RPG where Randal and Matt embark on a tabletop role-playing adventure, with Charlie as their Dungeon Master. Eager to finish the game as quickly as possible, they’ll have to deal with Charlie’s twisted challenges, facing combat, exploring dangerous dungeons and solving puzzles.

games.name: Random Slot Adventurers : Matched Words... Now I'm the Strongest
games.summary: Build a 3x3 slot board in this word-combination strategy roguelike. Combine Subjects, Adverbs, and Verbs to attack, defend, and heal. Explore changing islands, collect words and relics, and shape a build around class traits and synergies.

games.name: Resettle
games.summary: Resettle is a deep incremental city builder where you develop settlements on islands. Strategically place buildings to maximize resource production, explore 10 different upgrade systems, and create a thriving island city.

games.name: Stable Champs
games.summary: Build your stable. Chase the Golden Silks. Buy, breed and train racehorses, develop your yard and plan your Flat or Jumps campaign in this single-player management sim. Watch races unfold in 3D, become Champion Trainer and return to defend your title.

games.name: Streaming Tycoon
games.summary: Run a streaming company under a board that can fire you. Negotiate with stars, produce films, series and shows, and refresh your catalogue as audiences lose interest. Build a talent agency and choose which contracts, productions and risks are worth taking.

games.name: Summonforge: Idle RPG
games.summary: Compete with other players for the top spot on the leaderboards! Summon 80 unique heroes, build powerful teams, and conquer endless worlds in this fantasy idle RPG. Fuse champions, evolve skills, collect legendary equipment, and keep progressing even while offline!

games.name: The Idle Witch and Her Tower of BOOOOM!
The Seven Beacons
games.summary: An idle RPG that lives in a thin strip above your Windows taskbar. While you work, your party fights on its own through 22 zones toward the Demon King. On a short break, open the panel: gear, talents, farm, alchemy, forge, and seven beacons to defend.

games.name: The Turret and the Hare
games.summary: A cute, chunky auto-shooter tower defense. Your rider's cannon fires on its own: pick the upgrades, grow the tower from wood to steel, send guns on carts to hunt, and blast critter hordes through day, night and storms. 18 riders, VS and co-op with friends.

games.name: Tidy Up the Flower Shop: Christmas
games.summary: Return to the flower shop for a Christmas tidy-up. Sort 16 festive flower varieties, stock gifts, decorate the tree, and discover the notes left behind.

games.name: TURBOCARDS
games.summary: Klondike, Spider and FreeCell for your computer and your handheld. Play with mouse, keyboard or controller — however you like, on whatever you like. Four skin sets, modifiers and a Daily Challenge with verified deals. Windows, macOS, Linux and SteamOS.

games.name: Vela
games.summary: Vela is a relaxing solitaire card game. Group cards to create tricks based of their landscapes, seasons and elements. Weather phenomena will multiply your trick scores in surprising ways! Every game is random, offering virtually infinite replayability.

games.name: Volleyball Coach Simulator 2027
games.summary: Take charge of a men’s or women’s volleyball club. Recruit players, plan every training session, set your tactics and coach each point live. Rise from your domestic league to the European cups, lead a national team and build your legacy, alone or with up to 10 coaches.

Prove that you have what it takes to be part of Hollywood!Act It out makes you the director and the star in your own mini movie, but don’t give away the name of it.
